entry.title: Show HN: Oak - Git alternative designed for agents (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
entry.summary: Oak is a version control system I've been working on designed for agents (https://oak.space). It improves the speed and context your agents need when working on serious projects. With virtual mounts, agents locally and in the cloud no longer need a full copy of a repo to get working. You can work on many tasks in parallel without needing to download everything or fight worktrees. Version control shouldn't waste you or your agents time. It should be fast, creative and fun to make things with agents. Oak is still early in development. There's no Windows build and missing plenty of features (no CI, no issues, no comments). We still use GitHub Actions for building Oak now, but we've been fully bootstrapped on Oak with no Git backup for several months: https://oak.space/oak/oak. Blog post: https://oak.space/blog#git-is-forever Docs: https://oak.space/docs Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48631726 Points: 148 # Comments: 143

entry.title: Yandex Open-Sources YaFF: A Zero-Copy Wire Format for Protobuf With Near-Struct Read Speed (Source: www.marktechpost.com | Category: Extras)
entry.summary: In this article we look at YaFF, Yandex's open-source zero-copy wire format for the Protobuf ecosystem. We keep the .proto file as the single source of truth, changing only how data sits in memory. We walk through its four layouts - Fixed, Flat, Sparse, and Dynamic - and the benchmark where Flat Layout reads within 1.2× of a raw C++ struct. We also cover where it fits, including the advertising recommendation system reporting 10-20% CPU savings at production scale. The post Yandex Open-Sources YaFF: A Zero-Copy Wire Format for Protobuf With Near-Struct Read Speed appeared first on MarkTechPost.

entry.title: How to Build a Forecasting Pipeline with TimeCopilot Using Foundation Models and Automated Anomaly Detection (Source: www.marktechpost.com | Category: Extras)

We then explore TimeCopilot's optional LLM agent, which selects a model and explains its predictions.
